description: A collection of .NET templates for creating Power Platform components using a code-first approach. These templates will allow you to quickly scaffold projects with pre-configured settings and structure.
releaseNotes:
1.22.0:
  Highlights

  - Added pp-page-generative for scaffolding Power Platform generative page projects backed by the new GenPage build SDK support.
  - Upgraded pp-sitemap-subarea with page type choices for UCI pages, including generative pages, and added title/XML escaping support.
  - Fixed pp-security-role-privilege generation by resolving CS8803, .NET 10 JSON serialization compatibility, and doubled .template.scripts output paths.
  - Added a Playwright-based pp-test-ui template and renamed the older Selenium template to pp-test-ui-selenium while excluding it from the NuGet package.
  - Updated generated Dataverse projects to use TALXIS.DevKit.Build.Sdk/1.5.0.

  Full Changelog: https://github.com/TALXIS/tools-devkit-templates/compare/v1.21.0...v1.22.0

1.21.0:
  Highlights

  - Redesigned pp-script-library around Rollup and UMD output so script libraries can use npm imports and still publish a Dataverse-compatible browser bundle.
  - Simplified script-library structure by removing the TS/ nesting, generating project-root TypeScript sources, and letting dotnet build run the npm/Rollup workflow end-to-end.
  - Replaced PowerShell-based flow GUID generation with template-engine symbols, including correct upper/lower casing for filenames and WorkflowId attributes.
  - Moved flow schemaVersion to the root level for Dataverse import compatibility.
  - Updated generated Dataverse projects to use TALXIS.DevKit.Build.Sdk/1.4.0.

  Full Changelog: https://github.com/TALXIS/tools-devkit-templates/compare/v1.20.0...v1.21.0

1.20.0:
  Highlights

  - Expanded pp-entity-attribute to cover full Maker/Dataverse/SDK parity, including additional text, numeric, money, datetime, lookup, option set, file, image, bigint, and JSON text scenarios.
  - Added support for Autonumber, RichText, and Money AccuracySource combinations in pp-entity-attribute.
  - Migrated SolutionRootPath handling to the __dunder__ convention and unified descriptions across templates.
  - Added componentType tags to templates for improved component classification.
  - Fixed pp-ribbon-button scaffolding by creating RibbonDiff.xml when missing, fixing location handling, and migrating to dunder placeholders.
  - Updated generated Dataverse projects to use TALXIS.DevKit.Build.Sdk/1.3.0.
  - Normalized the template package fallback version to 0.0.1; release package versions now come from the GitHub release tag.

  Full Changelog: https://github.com/TALXIS/tools-devkit-templates/compare/v1.19.2...v1.20.0

1.19.2:
  Fixes
  - pp-flow: post-action finds GenerateFlowId.ps1 correctly (53)
  - pp-entity-view: savedqueryid gets valid GUID with braces from template engine (54)
  - pp-solution: gracefully handles missing .sln/.slnx (52)
  - Build SDK bumped to v1.2.2

1.19.1:
  Fixes
  - pp-flow: post-action finds GenerateFlowId.ps1 correctly (53)
  - pp-entity-view: savedqueryid gets valid GUID with braces directly from template engine (54)
  - Build SDK reference bumped to v1.2.1

  Changes
  - View template uses {someexampleid} pattern in both filename and XML content
  - SetFormId.ps1 is now a safe fallback, not required for GUID generation

1.19.0:
  What's new

  pp-flow template
  New template for scaffolding Power Automate cloud flows with minimal structure (manual button trigger, no connector assumptions).
  Parameters: PublisherPrefix, LogicalName.

  Build SDK 1.2.0
  All solution project templates now reference TALXIS.DevKit.Build.Sdk 1.2.0 which includes the new ValidateWorkspace task and platform-metadata v0.4.0 XSD schemas.

1.18.0:
  .csx → .NET 10 file-based apps
  - All 7 .csx scripts migrated to .cs — dotnet-script no longer required
  - .NET 10 SDK runs them natively via dotnet run --file
  - All .ps1 callers use -PassThru + $proc.ExitCode for proper exit code handling

  View template GUID fix
  - pp-entity-view now auto-generates view GUID (type: generated with generator: guid)
  - Previously left {customViewIdexample} placeholder in filename and savedqueryid

  Plugin template improvements
  - pp-plugin-assembly: cross-platform Path.Combine, exit code check, RootComponent.xml pre-check
  - pp-plugin-assembly-step: AssemblyName parameter with auto-default, recursive assembly search, clean __dunder__ placeholders, null check on plugin type lookup
  - Removed unused AssemblyId parameter from step template

  Build SDK 1.0.0 reference
  - All template .csproj files reference TALXIS.DevKit.Build.Sdk/1.0.0

1.17.0:
  Plugin template improvements

  pp-plugin-assembly
  - Fixed cross-platform paths in GenerateAssembly.csx (Path.Combine)
  - GenerateAssembly.ps1: proper exit code check (-PassThru + $proc.ExitCode)
  - AddAssemblyToSolution.ps1: pre-check RootComponent.xml existence

  pp-plugin-assembly-step
  - Scripts search PluginAssemblies/ recursively — works with both build-generated and pp-plugin-assembly layouts
  - AssemblyName parameter with auto-default (PluginProjectName with dots removed)
  - SetPluginTypeId.ps1: null check on plugin type lookup
  - AddFilteringAttributes.ps1: exit code check
  - Removed unused AssemblyId parameter

  Placeholder cleanup (plugin templates only)
  Legacy example tokens in pp-plugin-assembly and pp-plugin-assembly-step replaced with __dunder__ convention for collision safety. Other templates not yet updated.

  Build SDK
  - Template .csproj files updated to reference TALXIS.DevKit.Build.Sdk/1.0.0

  Release process
  - Unified: GitHub Release trigger (was push to master), version from tag, release notes in NuGet package
